output_text: <laravel-boost-guidelines>Laravel Boost guidelines curated by Laravel maintainers. Follow closely. This is a Laravel app; use versions: laravel/framework v12, laravel/prompts v0, laravel/mcp v0, laravel/pint v1, laravel/sail v1, phpunit/phpunit v11. Follow app code conventions; when creating/editing a file, check siblings for structure, approach, naming. Use descriptive names (e.g. `isRegisteredForDiscounts`). Check existing components to reuse. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover functionality and prove it works; prefer unit/feature tests. Stick to existing directory structure—don’t create new base folders without approval. Do not change dependencies without approval. If user doesn’t see frontend change in UI, ask them to run `bun run build`, `bun run dev`, or `composer run dev`. Be concise. Only create documentation files if explicitly requested. Laravel Boost is an MCP server; use its tools. Use `list-artisan-commands` to confirm Artisan command parameters. Use `tinker` to execute PHP to debug/query Eloquent. Use `database-query` to read only. Use `browser-logs` for recent browser logs/errors/exception
